fixed.initConstruction: Deterministically inject lifecycle-aware shared-provider accessors into the proven bundled baseline at pass generation time.

hostCompatibility.strategy: Preserve the user's unknown 0-Engine source and inject an additive Engine.GCET bridge immediately before its proven final exported runtime table.
structuralRequirements: source-visible assignment for the final exported identifier
simple final return of that identifier
no executable source after the export
hostCompatibility.collisionPolicy: Never overwrite a foreign file at the private G-CET support-module path.
hostCompatibility.lazyRuntimePolicy: Frame and action hooks are registered only when a generated client actually subscribes.

policy.reason: Generated callback transforms need a small shared runtime API. Known G-CET 0-Engine states use the proven fixed runtime; other structurally compatible versions keep their own APIs and receive only the namespaced Engine.GCET compatibility bridge. Shared provider caches retain original Game.Get...() fallbacks and invalidate on player/session epoch changes.
